attributes.residual: RECLASSIFIED from STRUCTURAL (stfsu-only) to STACK_LAYOUT-dominant. The two findings that survive this pass: (a) OUR SOURCE WAS WRONG ABOUT THE BUFFER COUNT - the target passes r1+84 to the first MBWindowProject and r1+80 to the second, so it has TWO s16[2] locals where our loop body declares one and reuses it; splitting them reproduces the target's slot count and use-count multiset EXACTLY (21/21). (b) THE UNRESOLVED HALF is a 40-byte block-base offset: no declaration arrangement tried places the 48-byte pad at the BOTTOM of the local block, because MWCC's own bit-trick temporaries (six of them, from the six FloatBits and-mask operations) are placed by the compiler and straddle whatever declared pad is present. UNPARK CONDITION: a way to make MWCC allocate its expression temporaries ABOVE a declared pad rather than around it - or the recognition that the 48 bytes at 8-55 in the target are not a pad at all but an outgoing-argument area, in which case the lever is the call signature, not a local. Do NOT re-probe the four declaration arrangements above.
